text:
maya: Heads-up — product asked for a canary dashboard that compares latency + correctness between model v3 and v4 across the rollout slice. Need infra+runtime telemetry inputs.

simon: +1. We should be explicit about dimensions: route, model_version, rollout_id, region, and slice (user_cohort). Also runtime node id for variance.

ellie: For latency, let's capture p50/p95/p99 and mean in ms. For correctness we'll use rollout.regression_score and a simple pass_rate from eval hooks.

ryan: Agree. Also include runtime.kv_cache_hit_rate, batching.size_mean, and infra.gpu_utilization. Those explain latency/cost deltas.

maya: Suggested minimal metric list: runtime.request_latency_ms{quantile}, runtime.error_count, runtime.responses_per_min, rollout.regression_score, runtime.kv_cache_hit_rate, infra.gpu_util_percent, routing.fallback_rate

simon: Can we standardize naming and tags? Prometheus labels: route, model_version, rollout_id, slice, region, env. Otherwise dashboard queries get messy.

ellie: Yep. I'll draft a telemetry contract: metrics must be emitted with those labels, and rollout.regression_score should include baseline_model_version and candidate_model_version as labels.

ryan: For the comparative panels, propose: (1) small-multiples time series for latency by model_version, (2) heatmap of delta (candidate - baseline) for p95 across slices, (3) scatter plot: kv_cache_hit_rate vs p95 to show correlation, (4) bar for error_rate by route.

maya: Nice. How do we compute delta in PromQL? example: delta_p95 = (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(runtime_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model_version)) - on() histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(... ) by (le, model_version))) )

simon: That expression is messy. Better approach: record two range vectors into recording rules: p95_by_model_version and then use p95_candidate - p95_baseline using label_replace to align rollout_id.

ellie: Also need an automated regression signal: if p95 increases > 20% AND rollout.regression_score drops > 0.05 for any slice -> alert to #oncall-rollouts. Add cooldown 10m to avoid noisy flips.

observability-bot: Reminder: new metrics must be onboarded via observability repo PR. See CONTRIBUTING.md for instrumentation checklist: labels, cardinality limits, unit tests.

ryan: One more ask — include a per-request tag for routing.policy (e.g., policy=latency|cost|fallback) so we can attribute changes to routing decisions.

maya: Good call. That lets Console show a per-policy breakdown in the rollout UX. I'll put together a mock dashboard wireframe and the telemetry contract PR this afternoon.

simon: I'll add recording rules and a couple demo panels in grafana sandbox. Ellie's PR for regression alerting should reference the new recording rules.

ellie: Will do. Quick question: what cardinality budget for slice? Product wants fine-grained cohorts (country + plan). We should cap at 200 slices.

ryan: Cap 200 sounds reasonable. Observability-bot: please enforce label cardinality checks on PRs.

observability-bot: Received. I'll run a cardinality scan on PRs and report any label growth > 200.

maya: Thanks all. Next steps: ellie PR for alerting, simon PR for recording rules, maya PR for telemetry contract + dashboard mock. Ping this thread when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
